"# Scope: CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization

## Architecture
The CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization brings a Google TV / cinema-grade design system to the `com.cinejoy.tv` webOS 8.5 application running at 1920x1080 on the LG 32LR686BPSA television, based on the reference project `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`.

"# Dispatch: Milestone UI-M4 Explorer 1 (10-Foot Spatial Focus Styling)

## Mission
Investigate `app/css/navigation.css`, `app/css/components.css`, `app/css/layout.css`, and `app/css/tokens.css` to audit and standardize 10-foot spatial focus states across ALL interactive components in CineJoy webOS.

## Inputs to Read
1. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md` (read verbatim intent)
2. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/orchestrator_ui/SCOPE.md`
3. `app/css/navigation.css`
4. `app/css/tokens.css`
5. `app/css/components.css`
6. `app/css/layout.css`

## Objectives
1. Audit all focus selectors: `.focused`, `.tv-focused`, and `:focus`.
2. Standardize Google TV / cinema 10-foot spatial focus hierarchy:
   - Elevation: `transform: scale(1.08)` to `scale(1.10)` (`!important` where needed for TV compositor).
   - High-contrast white halo ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #FFFFFF, 0 0 28px rgba(149, 255, 80, 0.65)` (or component-appropriate lime glow).
   - Inverted contrast dynamic on buttons/pills: surface flips to `#FFFFFF`, text/icons flip to `#202124` (15.9:1 contrast, WCAG AAA).
   - Card surfaces (220x330 poster, 320x180 episode, hero spotlight): high-contrast border + halo glow without clipping sibling elements.
   - Header navigation pills (`.pill`, `.tab`): capsule elevation and active indicator contrast.
   - Virtual keyboard keys: 72x64px keys elevation and white halo.
3. Verify CSS transition curves: `transition: transform 0.2s var(--cinema-ease-decel), box-shadow 0.2s var(--cinema-ease-decel)`.
4. Ensure hardware acceleration: `transform: translateZ(0)` on focusable containers, avoiding jitter or layout reflows.
5. Formulate concrete, surgical edits for `app/css/navigation.css` and `app/css/components.css`.

## Deliverables
- Detailed investigation report in `report.md`.
- Standard self-contained handoff in `handoff.md`.
- Notify orchestrator using `send_message`.
"

## Mission
Investigate `app/js/navigation.js` and modal structures across `app/js/views/details.js`, `app/js/views/search.js`, and `app/js/player.js` to audit and harden modal focus traps and spatial focus restoration.

## Inputs to Read
1. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md` (read verbatim intent)

## Objectives
1. Audit `SpatialNav` core algorithms:
   - Directional candidate search (`findNextFocusable`)
   - 2D distance calculation (Manhattan vs Euclidean projection)
   - Scope boundaries and container nesting
2. Audit modal focus trapping mechanism:
   - `SpatialNav.trap(modalContainer)` and `SpatialNav.untrap()`
   - Behavior under high-speed remote hammering (ensure zero focus escapes to underlying inactive views)
   - Verified modals:

3. Focus Restoration Contract:
   - Upon modal dismissal, focus MUST deterministically restore to the invoking trigger element (`triggerElement` cache).
   - If trigger element is no longer attached or hidden, fallback to a safe container default.
4. Verify non-negotiable invariants:
